study: Prospective cost-aware sustained-link recovery with fixed JEPA
primary_comparisons: Three fixed comparisons: repair minus legacy for each of the two forecast families, and repaired original JEPA minus repaired RadioMap; full three-test budget even if development stops confirmation.
development: No tuning/selection. Per cost, stop confirmation if either family mean repair-minus-legacy loss exceeds 0.01 absolute (one percentage point), or integrity/paid-cost/consumption checks fail. Recompute from raw archives. Otherwise fixed repair proceeds.
execution_order: Fixed seeded random permutation within each site block; complete that site before next, same two workers. Archive order before first new world.
source_scope: Previous aggressive slow-cost development results are already observed and retained. The separate fast confirmation is retained independently. This NEW registration precedes only cost-aware development/confirmation on new sites. No old reserved or vetoed site is reused, no old result or criterion changes, no fitting or retiming.
model_choice: Original frozen three-member FleetJEPA (lowest prior fresh-test point means) and strong RadioMap fixed package comparators. No objective/architecture claim; prior compact negatives retained.
controller_legacy: Original slow OutageUtility30 scores, reactive_rescue confidence and separate all-handover admission for ordinary planned and reactive actions, with no local watchdog.
controller_repair: KEEP original slow ordinary planned/reactive all-handover admission, confidence, cached-neighbor behavior and scores. Add completed fresh-scan observation recovery after the existing200ms silence threshold. Permit a separate local emergency handover only after420PRIMARY-RADIO-AVAILABLE silent slots (existing20stopslots plus configured4s outage), poor current pilot and fresh heard alternative>=8dBbetter. Reset the evidence counter on delivery, association change or known primary handover unavailability; pause during scans. Our own4s outage cannot justify another handover. Pay every90ms scan and4s handover outage; no fast-path bypass of ordinary admission.
runtime: ALL legacy/exact/repair main/fresh arms use SAME completion-safe queue: compute=max(reused sealed profile,predictor elapsed,measured history snapshot/forecast validation/storage/hash issue elapsed); service=compute+0.5s. Never release before actual accounted completion. Old profiles reused without retiming. Startup/loading separate.
timing_claim_contract: NEW prospective actual-cost experiment: profile exceedance is reported capacity diagnostic because actual cost is paid. Undercharge/premature consumption/nonfinite/source/causality/offline-replay failure veto experimental benefit. Previous global-overrun veto untouched. Production/hardware qualification always false.
controller_compute_scope: Admission/scorer CPU may be recorded but not individually scheduled; shared0.5s scheduling/other-work delay remains an assumption. Actual forecast issue measured. No full-stack real-time/hardware guarantee.

conditions: Even stationary/odd hidden drift; shared procedural CAD,60-second episodes,conditional60-second warm history,assumed scanning/localization/plans/native PHY curves.
minimum_handover_silence_formula: Available-radio control-silence slots >= SAFETY_GAP_SLOTS + ceil(policy.roam_cost_s/SLOT), i.e.420slots at4s. Reset on successful control delivery or known handover unavailability; pause during scan outage. Our own4s handover is not evidence of a failed current link.
